{{Quote|Nice entrance, Skywalker. How do you plan to get us out of this mess?''"<br />"''Well, I have a ship docking in the lower hangar as we speak.|Aayla Secura and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>}}
A '''''Consular''-class cruiser''' was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], used by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to evacuate [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and her crew from the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']] during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]]. It was destroyed when it crashed on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].
